endTime.description: Defines time to stop scheduling transfer runs. A transfer run cannot be scheduled at or after the end time. The end time can be changed at any moment. The time when a data transfer can be triggered manually is not limited by this option.

startTime.description: Specifies time to start scheduling transfer runs. The first run will be scheduled at or after the start time according to a recurrence pattern defined in the schedule string. endTime.description: End time of the range of transfer runs. For example, `"2017-05-30T00:00:00+00:00"`. The end_time must not be in the future. Creates transfer runs where run_time is in the range between start_time (inclusive) and end_time (exclusive).
